_about: Research (1.0.70): the tree. tier 1-5 sets cost and levels (research.json costs/levels); requires: ids (a|b = either; * = every other project in the branch); scope lobby = the host's research decides it for everyone (or anyone's, Research/LobbyRule), you = your own. built = false: shown in the tree but can't be started yet (still in development).

projects.name: Cart Winch
projects.unlock: Look at a cart 3-10 m away and hold Interact (E) to reel it toward you (slowly; it stops if it hits something).

projects.name: Extraction Drill
projects.unlock: When every living player stands in an extraction zone, its countdown runs twice as fast.

projects.name: Recall Beacon
projects.unlock: Once per level, call the nearest empty cart to where you stand (Research tab, in a level).

projects.name: Trailer Hitch
projects.unlock: Push a cart into another to hitch them: pushing one tows the other. Yank them apart to unhitch.

projects.name: Twin Pads
projects.unlock: The Courier can put a second Drop Pad anywhere (Research tab, in a level). It counts like the one in the truck.

projects.name: Insulated Cart
projects.unlock: Once per level, mark the nearest cart (Research tab): its valuables lose no value from bumps while it stands still.

projects.name: Dumbwaiter
projects.unlock: Every extraction point gets a chute: once per point, leave one valuable on it and it's sent straight to the open extraction.

projects.name: Price Board
projects.unlock: The shop's Research section shows next visit's featured deal, and that deal will be exactly that item.

projects.name: Haggling
projects.unlock: Once per shop visit, haggle one item: 50% chance it's 25% cheaper, 50% chance it's 10% dearer (that visit).

projects.name: Rotation Lock
projects.unlock: Lock one more shop item (3 at most), and your first lock each shop visit is free.

projects.name: The Archivist
projects.unlock: A new contract giver whose contracts pay Research Data (samples, a full catalogue, specimens).

projects.name: Pawn Counter
projects.unlock: New shop section: pawn a gear item for 60% of its salvage, buy it back at 80% until the run ends.

projects.name: Futures
projects.unlock: New shop section: pay now for an item of a chosen rarity, delivered when the team clears the next milestone (one order per visit).

projects.name: Sponsors
projects.unlock: At run start the team picks one of three sponsors; each sets a run-long side goal and pays Scrap and Data at the run's end.

projects.name: Modules II
projects.unlock: Three new modules can drop and be bought: Tracer (monsters you hit are marked for the team for 3 s), Spotter Lens (aim at a valuable to see its value) and Tether (items you let go float for 1 s).

projects.name: Consumables II
projects.unlock: New shop consumables that go off on their own once per level: Smoke Canister (below 50% health, nearby monsters lose sight of you), Decoy Whistle (a monster gets close: a whistle draws monsters away) and Flash Charge (a monster gets very close: a flash stuns it).

projects.name: Behaviors II
projects.unlock: Four new behavior affixes can roll on your gear: Hasty, Momentum, Steady and Second Wind.

projects.name: Gun Bench
projects.unlock: Shop service: fit a Suppressor (quiet shots), Scatter Choke (an extra pellet, wider spread) or Stock (less kick) to the guns you hold next level.

projects.name: Fusion Forge
projects.unlock: Fuse three unequipped items of one slot and rarity into one item a rarity higher (shop Research section; not Uniques, cursed or starter items).

projects.name: Blueprint Archive
projects.unlock: Uniques you've found before can appear in your shop (one per visit).

projects.name: Prototype Lab
projects.unlock: Each run, one prototype item with an effect only research gives (one of 6) appears in your shop.

projects.name: Sample Scanner
projects.unlock: Research samples within 25 m show as a ping on your screen.

projects.name: New Hazards
projects.unlock: Two map modifiers join the pool: Blackout (lights dimmed, monsters a little slower) and Supply Drop (a crate worth extra falls mid-level).

projects.name: Survey Drone
projects.unlock: Once per level (Research tab): a survey drone marks the valuables up to 22 m ahead of you for 10 s.

projects.name: Vault Cracking
projects.unlock: Some levels have a locked vault deep in the map: hold Interact on it for 6 s (monsters hear it) to crack it for more than double its value and Data.

projects.name: Nest Hunting
projects.unlock: Some levels have a Monster Nest: kill all its marked guards and the last one drops a nest core (Data when extracted).

projects.name: Expeditions
projects.unlock: A new route in the route vote: Expedition, with 40% more valuables, more monsters and twice the research samples.

projects.name: Anomaly Rooms
projects.unlock: Some maps have an anomaly deep inside: valuables float in low gravity around an anomaly sample worth a lot of Data.

projects.name: Boons II
projects.unlock: Four new run boons join the vote pool: Quick Study, Data Mine, Stockpile, Deep Pockets.

projects.name: Parallel Lab
projects.unlock: Run two research projects at once.

projects.name: Spectator Uplink
projects.unlock: While dead, press your ability key to mark the monster or valuable the spectate view looks at, for the living team.

projects.name: Synergies II
projects.unlock: Four new class-pair synergies: Iron Wall, Quick Patch, Study Group, Side Hustle.

projects.name: Gear Exchange
projects.unlock: Trade gear with a teammate in the shop's Research section: one item for one, both confirm.

projects.name: Crew Drills
projects.unlock: At each crew level the team votes one of three drills: a small team rule for the rest of the run.

projects.name: Lab Network
projects.unlock: Run three research projects at once, and once per run borrow one personal unlock a teammate has researched (Research tab).
